name: pycoin-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is richardkiss/pycoin, a Python library of bitcoin and altcoin utilities: base58,
bech32 and SEC encodings, ECDSA signatures, BIP32 hierarchical keys, network objects that parse and produce keys,
addresses and scripts, a bitcoin script virtual machine, and transaction serialisation, signing and validation. The
README, BIP32.txt and the pages under docs/ describe the library, and its modules document their functions and
classes with docstrings.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
The code under repair is pycoin's encoding, ecdsa, key, message, networks, satoshi, solve and vm packages, the
bitcoin support in pycoin/coins/bitcoin/ with the transaction modules Tx.py, TxIn.py, TxOut.py, SolutionChecker.py,
tx_utils.py and exceptions.py of pycoin/coins/, pycoin/contrib/msg_signing.py, pycoin/contrib/who_signed.py,
pycoin/contrib/bech32m.py, pycoin/block.py and pycoin/merkle.py.
The documentation in scope is: README.md, BIP32.txt, docs/index.rst, docs/api.rst, docs/bitcoin.rst,
docs/source/contract.rst, docs/source/pycoin.ecdsa.rst and the module, class and function docstrings of the modules
under repair.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is those pages and those
docstrings; in-package co
